name: Items of Some Consequence
summary: Tyrion needs silk and apples to prepare Spybot for a covert approach to Lord Lescovar in Stormwind Keep. The mechanical spy must pass the royal guards and listen to the noble.

sections.title: A Tightening Schedule
sections.body: Elling Trias, the cheese merchant, has moved the operation against Lord Gregor Lescovar forward. He suspects Lescovar's schemes in Stormwind Keep threaten the realm. Tyrion agrees to the tighter schedule in the keep's gardens, but Spybot's disguise needs careful preparation.

sections.title: The Art of the Disguise
sections.body: Tyrion plans to send Spybot, a small mechanical contraption, past the castle guards to reach Lescovar inside the keep. Its strange disguise as a woman should turn suspicion aside. You gather suitably sized apples from Clara's orchard just outside the city walls, along with bolts of silk for the puppet's clothes.

sections.title: Uncovering Treason
sections.body: Tyrion first watched Lord Lescovar over suspicious leads linking the noble to the Twilight's Hammer cult. He now reveals that Lescovar is also colluding with Defias conspirators. With that treachery exposed, Lescovar can no longer remain in the royal court. Tyrion's surveillance becomes a sting at the heart of the kingdom.

faq.q: Why does Tyrion need apples and silk cloth?
faq.answer: Tyrion needs apples and silk to disguise Spybot as a woman so it can pass the royal guards in Stormwind Keep. The silk becomes clothing, and the apples give the disguise its shape.
Tyrion works with Elling Trias, a Trade District cheese merchant who runs his own network of friends in Stormwind. Trias says the operation only indirectly does a favor for Mathias Shaw and SI:7.

faq.q: Where do I find Clara's apples?
faq.answer: Clara's orchard is just outside Stormwind's city gates in northern Elwynn Forest. You can gather fresh apples around the farm.

faq.q: What did Tyrion originally suspect Lord Lescovar of doing?
faq.answer: Tyrion and Trias first suspected Lord Lescovar had ties to the Twilight's Hammer cult. They later uncovered his collaboration with the Defias Brotherhood, a deeper treason and an imminent threat to the crown.

faq.q: What is the next step after delivering these items?
aliases: next quest after items of some consequence
faq.answer: After Spybot is outfitted and sent into the keep, you are tasked with confronting and eliminating the conspirators in 'The Attack!'.

faq.q: Why use a mechanical spybot instead of sneaking in personally?
faq.answer: Stormwind Keep's royal sentries scrutinize everyone entering the throne room and private courtyards. Disguised as a priestess, Spybot can pass them, speak with Lescovar, and draw him into the garden to meet Marzon, where no known agent could get close.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can see how operatives like Tyrion and Elling Trias use unorthodox surveillance, with domestic intelligence working under the nobles' noses.
As a Tailor, you know fine silk can aid undercover schemes as well as make formal gowns.
As an Alliance member, you help protect the young King Anduin and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon by rooting out corrupt aristocrats who conspire with outlaws inside Stormwind Keep.
